reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in 2024
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr_then AS (  -- one row per cohort account, with its MRR at the end of month 6
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = c.account_id
  WHERE e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 7 MONTH
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) AS retained_accounts,
       1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
FROM mrr_then
GROUP BY cohort_month
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.mrr > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_accounts,
       AVG(CASE WHEN m.mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS retention_rate
FROM accounts a
JOIN (  -- one row per account, with its MRR at the end of the month 6 months after its cohort month
  SELECT x.account_id, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr
  FROM accounts x
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = x.account_id
  WHERE e.event_date <= CAST(date_trunc('month', x.created_at) + INTERVAL 7 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE)
  GROUP BY x.account_id
) AS m ON m.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND a.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1

       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                               WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id

                                     WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id
                                       AND e.event_date < c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 7 MONTH) > 0) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort c
GROUP BY c.cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cm FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
),
m AS (
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cm, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM c LEFT JOIN subscription_events e
    ON e.account_id = c.account_id AND e.event_date < CAST(c.cm + INTERVAL 7 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.cm
)
SELECT cm AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) AS retained_accounts,
       1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) AS retention_rate
FROM m
GROUP BY cm
